name: Ironstone Gargoyle
tactics: In the world, ironstone gargoyles lurk along mountain passes or infest stone towers. They are active at night, lurking motionless as they wait for victims to pass. The gargoyles attack as a pack, killing victims outright or driving them toward the edges of cliffs.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Lurking Presence
traits.details: The ironstone gargoyle gains a +10 bonus to Stealth checks against enemies’ passive Perception.

effect.description: The gargoyle shifts 4 squares and uses claw against two different targets at any point during the shift. When an attack hits, the gargoyle slides the target 1 square and knocks it prone.
The gargoyle flies 4 squares without provoking opportunity attacks.
